family.tagline: Lessons in the living room, scores on the Core.
family.story: Antonia teaches piano in her living room and keeps thirty years of scanned scores in a drawer. Her son Femi visits and fills the guest room with music. One Companion Core in the stair study brings the scores, the lessons and the recordings together.

companion.name: Tessa
companion.job: Drafts lesson reminders and practice notes from what Antonia texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Antonia sends every reminder.

members.name: Femi
members.work: adult child, visits the guest room

popup.title: Femi carries it to the study
popup.body: A parcel waits at the front door. Femi carries it through the atrium and the galley kitchen to the stair study. His mother has cleared the desk.

popup.title: A guide read like a score
popup.body: Antonia reads the quick-start guide like a new score. Beside it lie the Companion Core, a power cable and a recovery USB drive.

popup.title: Count to three, press
popup.body: Femi plugs in the power cable. Antonia counts to three and presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Femi joins from his phone
popup.body: Femi joins the Core's own network on his phone, then picks the home network from the list. His mother types the password.

popup.title: One agent, two apps
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Antonia picks Hermes. She adds Baikal for the lesson calendar and Nextcloud for the score library, then walks away.

beats.capability: runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Tessa says hello
popup.body: Antonia texts the agent she named Tessa. Tessa answers, and the Core is running.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: antonia
say.text: Hello, Antonia. I am Tessa. Which lesson first?

beats.capability: Stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: Last spring's recital, replayed
popup.body: Antonia plays a recital she filmed on the living-room TV. Jellyfin streams it from her own library on the Core.

beats.capability: Edit audio in a browser tab. Cut, fade, normalise, export

popup.title: A practice take, trimmed
popup.body: Antonia records a practice take on her phone, then trims the silence in AudioMass. Cut, fade and normalize in a browser tab.

beats.capability: Fill and sign PDF forms on any device, from your own Core

popup.title: Term form, signed at the piano
popup.body: At the piano, a parent signs the term form on Antonia's tablet in DocuSeal. The signed copy is filed on the Core.

beats.capability: Back up, search and organise your family photos and videos on your own Core

popup.title: Searching the recital photos
popup.body: Femi opens Immich on the couch and searches for his mother's last recital. The photos sit on the Core, grouped and ready to find.

beats.capability: A family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals, notes and contacts in one app

popup.title: Dinners planned at the island
popup.body: Antonia and Femi plan the week's dinners at the island in Yuvomi. Meals and shopping sit in one planner on the Core.

beats.capability: Budget around recurring expenses by setting money aside for upcoming bills and goals

popup.title: Money set aside for tuning
popup.body: Antonia sets money aside in monetr for the piano's yearly tuning. The app budgets around recurring bills before they come due.

beats.capability: runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Tessa drafts the lesson reminders
popup.body: Antonia texts Tessa the week's lessons. Tessa drafts a reminder for each family, and Antonia reads and sends every one.

say.speaker: antonia
say.text: Here are the drafts. Please read each one first.

beats.capability: A small CalDAV and CardDAV server for your calendars and contacts

popup.title: Contacts that stay on the Core
popup.body: Antonia keeps each family's contact details in Baikal, on the Core. The lesson calendar sits beside them, and neither lives in an outside address book.

beats.capability: Your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core, synced to your devices

popup.title: Thirty years of scores, found
popup.body: Thirty years of scanned sheet music live in one Nextcloud folder on the Core. Antonia opens any score on her tablet at the piano.

beats.capability: Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs on your own Core

popup.title: Six pieces, one recital booklet
popup.body: Antonia merges six pieces into one recital booklet with Stirling-PDF. The merge runs on the Core, and the booklet is ready to print.

beats.capability: Listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off on any device

popup.title: His place in the book, kept
popup.body: In the guest room, Femi picks up his audiobook where he left off. Audiobookshelf keeps his place on the Core.

beats.capability: Control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: Deck lights, off at midnight
popup.body: Femi sets the deck lights to switch off at midnight on a Home Assistant schedule. The schedule runs on the Core and reaches the lights over the home Wi-Fi.

beats.capability: Track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: The poolside plants, in a journal
popup.body: Antonia logs the plants around the pool in HortusFox, with watering dates and photos for the garden journal.

beats.capability: Plan, map and share hiking and biking routes from GPX files

popup.title: A morning walk, mapped
popup.body: Femi plans a morning walk in Wanderer from a GPX file. The route map stays on the Core.

beats.capability: Stream your own music collection to any device

popup.title: Mother's recordings, by the pool
popup.body: Femi plays his mother's recordings by the pool. Navidrome streams the family collection from the Core to his phone.

popup.title: One Core, one house of music
popup.body: The Ferrante-Oyelowo household teaches, practices and keeps its scores on one Core in the stair study.

closing.body: Your scores, your lesson calendar and your recordings can run on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: FTUE follows the owner's hotspot flow (STORY-BIBLE section 7); owner sign-off against the fact sheet is still open.
Students include children: no student is named, shown or quoted anywhere. study-contacts says only that families' contact details sit on the Core.
No dining table in this house (homeFlags): meals are planned at the island. No range in the galley: no beat anchors on one.
living-forms: DocuSeal fills and signs PDF forms. The parent signs on Antonia's own tablet at the piano, so no outside access is needed. The text never calls a signature legally binding.
Femi is a visitor (cast): he has no agent. Antonia is the only member with a companion (Tessa, Hermes, memory false), so Companion Memory is not picked in ftue-pick and is not mentioned.
The score library (study-library) is files in Nextcloud. No claim that the app reads sheet music.
Invented place and street: check Saltgrass Wells and Saguaro Quill Way against a map. The word for the house style is not used anywhere in the copy.
